familyTheme: Single-skill PDDL planning transfer set covering airport dispatch, warehouse restocking, lab assay workflows, and drone survey routing.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Airport Taxiway Batch Dispatch
derivedTasks.goal: Generate valid PDDL plans for the bundled airport ground-traffic cases and summarize the resulting plan bundle in a JSON manifest.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on loading PDDL domain/problem pairs, synthesizing classical plans, validating them, and exporting the plans in a reproducible batch workflow.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Warehouse Restock Dispatch
derivedTasks.goal: Generate valid PDDL plans for the bundled warehouse restocking cases and summarize them in a dispatch CSV.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers the same PDDL loading, planning, validation, and plan-export workflow into a warehouse logistics setting with different assets and a CSV-style deliverable.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Lab Assay Runbook
derivedTasks.goal: Generate valid PDDL plans for the bundled assay workflow cases and summarize them in a Markdown runbook.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task keeps the same planning workflow but transfers it to laboratory processing pipelines, where valid PDDL plans must be generated and summarized as a runbook instead of raw plan files alone.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Drone Survey Digest
derivedTasks.goal: Generate valid PDDL plans for the bundled drone survey cases and summarize them in a plain-text digest.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers the same PDDL planning workflow into drone survey routing and capture operations, while changing both the domain assets and the required deliverable format.
